spans.text:
#define CHECK_Z(f) {                          \
    size_t const err = f;                     \
    if (ZSTD_isError(err)) {                  \
        DISPLAY("Error => %s : %s ",          \
                #f, ZSTD_getErrorName(err));  \
        exit(1);                              \
}   }
